decision.scope: The Lean assurance twin at the landed phase-2 scope: the kernel mirror (Schema, Instance, EvalPath, Check, Findings), the lake exe lean-parity oracle over the check-applicable fixture corpus, and the three proved theorems plus the label lemma. Bounded search, delta migration, and the rule lens stay unmodeled, and keys/coproduct completeness stays deferred (design Decision 3). `model_hashes` are plain sha256 digests of the file bytes of the two normative spec files this decision rests on, named in full: `openspec/specs/kernel-checks/spec.md` (sha256:4d0aab91…) and `openspec/specs/findings/spec.md` (sha256:754ea474…); they are file digests, not canonical-model re-encodings.
decision.rationale: Hold: the proof phase surfaced no kernel defect and no contract hole, so the evidence does not buy a follow-up. Fixture parity had already established operational equivalence on every check-applicable corpus document (190 enumerated, 180 Rust-compared, 79 findings-bearing agreement, 102 trivially agreeing, 0 divergences, and 0 build mismatches with --check-build); the proofs then established the universal statements the corpus cannot state: witness totality for every emitted finding (soundness, including the four exclusion theorems for naturality/redundant/contradiction/underconstraint), equation completeness with accepted-to-executed and proposed-to-hypothesized label agreement (equation_completeness and labelFor_agrees), and the five dangling-discipline clauses at Instance.build (dangling_discipline). All three compile sorry-free with only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. The friction found is proof engineering, not semantics: the finding-membership bridges are duplicated as private lemmas across Soundness and DanglingDiscipline, EquationCompleteness locally restates the equation family (equationFamily/equationFindings_eq), and the key membership bridge is deliberately one-directional because KeyCollision does not carry the dense-row-space conjunct the walk supplies (sufficient for soundness; recorded for a consolidation pass). None of that blocked a statement, so it is not a hole. Extend would have to buy a new theorem family — bounded-search FOUND/EXHAUSTED/UNKNOWN honesty, delta-migration no_invented_rows/lost_data_complete/round-trip counterexample soundness, and the deferred key/coproduct completeness — plus formalization of catherine-analysis and migrate.rs and new fixtures, with no observed defect motivating that cost. Retire would discard the only machine-checked universal statements of the checker contract and the CI parity gate on a std-only tree that is cheap to keep. Maintain at the landed scope.
decision.fixture_only_comparison: Fixture-only assurance pinned the executable semantics: 190 documents enumerated, 180 compared against catherine check --json, 79 findings-bearing agreement, 102 trivially agreeing, 0 divergences, and 0 build mismatches under --check-build; malformed documents are recorded as skipped_parse rather than as agreement. On those documents the corpus already uniquely determined the semantics once the twin matched, but it can only sample and cannot quantify. The proofs add the universal half: every emitted finding carries its semantic witness for arbitrary schemas and instances (soundness), every semantic equation violation on an applicable row is reported with the agreed label (equation_completeness), and the dangling never-clauses hold over any built instance (dangling_discipline) — all sorry-free. Neither method found a defect: parity reported zero divergences and zero build mismatches, no kernel change was needed to elaborate the statements, and no theorem was unstateable (defects_found and holes_found are empty for that reason, not for lack of review). The corpus remains the drift detector; the theorems are the contract statement.
